press_references.value: ZAWYA: Deem Finance and Yusr announces strategic partnership to advance embedded finance and BNPL solutions in the UAE

partnership_announcements.description: Deem Finance and fintech firm Yusr signed a strategic partnership to offer embedded finance and BNPL solutions in the UAE, combining Deem’s regulated infrastructure with Yusr’s technology-led customer experience as Yusr expands into the UAE market.

press_references.value: Deem Finance partners with Biz2X to expand data-driven embedded finance for UAE SMEs

partnership_announcements.description: Deem Finance formed a strategic partnership with Biz2X to use its AI-powered lending platform for POS-based, data-driven SME financing in the UAE.

press_references.value: Deem Finance and airpay announce strategic partnership

press_references.value: Deem Finance named Title Sponsor of DSL Season 13

press_references.value: Deem Finance and J.P. Morgan partner with a milestone $400mln securitization facility to support consumer and SME lending in the UAE

partnership_announcements.description: Deem Finance and J.P. Morgan have partnered to create a $400 million securitization facility to support consumer and SME lending in the UAE. This partnership aims to enhance Deem's lending capabilities and diversify its funding sources.

about_short_description.short_description: Deem Finance is a finance company that offers cash-up credit cards, miles-up credit cards, and personal loan solutions and services.

product.name: Deem Credit Cards
product.description: Credit cards for UAE consumers that support everyday purchases and offer rewards through the Deem Joy Points program.

product.name: Deem Personal Loans
product.description: Personal financing for UAE individuals, intended for expenses such as home improvements, major purchases, and personal milestones.

product.name: Deem Merchant Loans
product.description: Business financing for merchants to fund operating needs, expansion, and other business activities.

product.name: Deem Business Deposits
product.description: Deposit products for businesses seeking to place funds with Deem for agreed terms and returns.

product.name: Deem Quick Merchant Loan
product.description: Collateral-free business financing of up to AED 200,000, with fast approvals and limited documentation for eligible merchants.

product.name: Deem Salary Advance
product.description: A salary-linked financing service that provides eligible employees with access to funds before their regular salary payment.
